chunks: "Bring him before the people," they said, "that they may bear witness."

key_terms.أَعْيُنِ: eyes (plural of 'ayn), meaning in the presence or sight of

ai.seo_question: How did the people of the Prophet (peace be upon him) respond to his message?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Anbiya, this verse captures the polytheists' demand to publicly expose Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to validate their accusations, reflecting the communal scrutiny of prophethood in Mecca. Shia exegesis often views this as a precursor to the ultimate divine validation of the Prophet's truthfulness, where the 'witnesses' of the people are contrasted with the true witnesses of God. It underscores the theme of public accountability and the eventual triumph of the chosen servant despite collective opposition.
